what: From the center of the background-color curtain covering the page, a hole opens like spreading ink. The radius grows over 3.56s (2.85 ÷ .8) from −margin to screen edge+margin, the edge scatters with swirl-warped noise (scale 4 · turbulence .78 · blur .18 · time ×1.2), and only the edge band ripples in ink color (inside light text color → outside faded color, mix .3). When fully open the canvas is removed and fx:revealed fires. Used where the first section opens after the loader.

options.delay: Wait before opening (sec), default 0 — as long as the loader
options.--fx-cover · --fx-ink-in · --fx-ink-out: Mask color · strip inner and outer colors (via style), default --kf-bg · --kf-ink · --kf-dim
options.fx:revealed: Event fired from the element once fully open — hang the next step here, such as first section text appearing

note: The curve is a function inside the original bundle and could not be read, so it was matched by eye — default 0.65,0,0.35,1

from.where: about.html main.br — after the original brand loader, .p-brand__ink (WebGL2 ink bleed · speed .8 · bloomDur 2.85 · noiseScale 4 · noiseSpeed 1.5 · turb .78 · edge .18 · inkMix .3)
